summary: Figure Technology Solutions filed an 8-K announcing a definitive merger agreement to acquire Kiavi, Inc. for $532.4 million in cash. Under the agreement, a wholly owned subsidiary will merge with Kiavi, with Kiavi surviving as a subsidiary. Consideration is all cash, subject to customary adjustments for cash, debt, and working capital. Conditions include HSR antitrust clearance, supermajority Kiavi equityholder approval, and a pre-closing restructuring. The filing does not name advisors or a board recommendation. Risk-arb watchers should monitor antitrust review and the concurrent joint venture sale.
